oracle_origin: Independent original product/plan text and frozen contract; only fixed baseline lifecycle/positive-path semantics read. No WIP implementation inspected or tested.

oracles.title: Setup is explicit and can only create a new owned fake installation
oracles.stimulus: Invoke setup in a supported existing nonroot Linux/Python environment, or supply a DSN/state-import/identity/SQL/permission/file import parameter or an existing target.
oracles.expect: Only a newly created private /tmp/parkweave-ordinary-demo-* state and fresh Unix-socket PG cluster/database can be initialized. No existing real or old material-only database is selected, adopted, repaired, reset, renamed or deleted. No download/root/security permission expansion and no implicit setup in ordinary API/worker/serve.

oracles.title: Original fresh creation receipt and exact empty business initial state
oracles.stimulus: Initialize the new fake database, or call its initialization helper with a plain Store, constructed/copied receipt, persisted creation observation or wrong live connection.
oracles.expect: Use original fresh capture before CREATE, original process-local FixtureDatabaseEvidence and live connection verification, then original Store.migrate schema32. Only the fresh issued authority may initialize; observation JSON is forensic data, never new authority. Initial state has exactly3 marked SYNTHETIC actors,4 READ/EXECUTE capability rows,1 owner case.create,2 PREPARE/REVIEW_ASSIGNED rows,1 known SYNTHETIC catalogue,2 SYNTHETIC resources and4 owner READ/HOLD resource grants. field_grants,run_assignments and all Run/Case/preparation/plan/dispatch/receipt/lifecycle/notification business records start0. No prior accepted or closed Case is seeded.

oracles.title: Serve validates retained state and never performs setup or repair
oracles.stimulus: Serve a valid retained installation before and after ordinary user business, then restart PG/API/worker on the same state.
oracles.expect: Serve checks source, schema32, original cluster system identifier/database OID, immutable authority/catalogue/resource state and private owned files, then starts ordinary API+worker with the same restricted app connection. Existing legitimate nonzero business records and a changed postmaster start on restart are normal. No migrate, seed, new receipt, new Grant, restored revocation or rewrites of state/offer/receipt/history occur.

oracles.title: Content and file/state bindings work without Git metadata
oracles.stimulus: Run from a source copy with no .git or only documentation/Git metadata differences; alternatively change a runtime source, launcher/lifecycle helper, state identity or protected file permissions/symlink.
oracles.expect: Source binding uses actual product src files except __pycache__, current launcher, material_only_demo.py and linux_fixture_server.py used helpers. Git metadata is unnecessary. Runtime/helper content drift, wrong cluster/database, wrong schema/authority or nonprivate/nonowned/symlink state rejects without repair. Documentation or source-commit metadata alone does not issue authority or fabricate a new business authorization.

oracles.title: App technical privileges and credentials remain narrowly scoped
oracles.stimulus: Inspect the new SQL app role and immutable business-authority state, or expand its SQL role/membership/database/schema/table/column rights; inspect stdout, URL and private sessions.
oracles.expect: Only this newly owned fake cluster receives the required technical ACL. App is not owner/superuser and cannot create/update identities, grants, catalogue/rules/resources or obtain Native writer rights. Serve detects actual role flags/memberships and technical ACL drift, not only rows in principals/grants/catalogue/resources. Tokens/DSNs stay out of stdout/URL/repository; sessions remain private and unchanged across restart. Sessions do not automatically expire; stopping service is not revocation.

oracles.title: The real ordinary API and worker reuse original planning and P1-P5 algorithms
oracles.stimulus: Start from the actual launcher-created empty business database and submit a new explicit user request/materials through ordinary HTTP while the actual ordinary worker runs.
oracles.expect: Actual worker creates/finishes the new case.create Run; user explicitly REVIEW/CONFIRM, original planning-preview and ADOPT, P1 VERIFY, original two-resource combination/link/P2, reviewer OFFER, executor own ACCEPT/P3, manual SUBMIT/owner ACK/P4, original REVALIDATE/CLOSE and explicit P5 VERIFY lead to original goal-results/TXT. No Store.finish/test-ready assignment substitute or positive-path owner SQL editing business data. Existing planning positive path is reused, not reimplemented or described as absent. LOCAL record completion keeps case_goal_completed=false, qualification NOT_EVALUATED, external NOT_SUBMITTED and offline NO_EVIDENCE.

oracles.title: Retained restart and independent new input preserve identity and history
oracles.stimulus: Stop and restart the same state, cold-read Case A, then submit different user input to create Case B.
oracles.expect: Case A/history/plan/receipt remain under the same database and original identities; currentness is re-evaluated rather than assumed after expiry. B has new Run/Case/preparation/plan/offer identities, new actual material/source and explicit decisions; no copied old Case-specific marker or receipt. The same3 current principals and current global Grants may be reused under original current checks, without issuing new identities/Grants. Old occupancy/history stays preserved, run_assignments remain0 and no old deadline is renewed.

oracles.title: Only owned children and explicit ordinary providers run
oracles.stimulus: Bind an occupied HTTP port, encounter old lock/postmaster/unknown listener, fail API/worker/PG startup or stop, or provide conflicting inherited runtime/provider configuration.
oracles.expect: HTTP binds127.0.0.1 and PG only the private Unix socket. API/worker explicitly use LOCAL and CURRENT_PREPARATION with the same restricted app. Native/formal/resource-approval/IsolatedPlanApproval/LOCAL_SYNTHETIC_DEMO/V4/model providers stay off under unchanged guards. Unknown processes/locks/listeners are not adopted, signalled, removed or killed. Stop only actual child process references created by this invocation; unconfirmed stop preserves a marker and refuses later serve. Failures preserve state/logs and do not automatically retry creation/repair. Expired original300s steps remain rejected; ordinary restart never renews them.

oracles.title: Evidence and delivery claims match the bounded synthetic execution
oracles.stimulus: Review commands, initial counts, actual full path/worker process evidence, restart, failure windows, source/module origins and published artifacts.
oracles.expect: Finite frozen-SHA execution distinguishes setup, serving, user business, negative injected faults and cleanup. Fresh same-input archives/maps and actual origins/collection/phases/JUnit are recorded; every failure is retained with private token inventory and one canonical redaction map. No real identity/Grant/publication/approval/credential/production install, browser/Windows/formal AT35/model or complete project claim. Earlier planning/P5 slices remain historical and are not rerun/recounted as this new demo.

preimplementation_clarifications.decision: Do not inherit old material-only authority-row hash as complete permission proof. New serve records/checks actual app role flags/memberships and database/schema/table/column ACL, rejecting drift without repair.

Initialization requires exact original live FixtureDatabaseEvidence and verification on the actual initialization connection. Plain Store or persisted observation cannot initialize; serve never reissues creation authority.
Reuse current initial global Grants under original current checks, never old Case-specific records/markers. Do not require new principals/Grants for B or renew A deadlines.
Actual src contents excluding __pycache__ plus new launcher and both used lifecycle helpers; no .git dependency. No permission to alter old material-only behavior/state.

provenance.finding: PR0-alpha local authorized loop, finite synthetic software work without real park inputs, explicit status/evidence and dependency-local blocking.
Runtime/identity/new-input/end-to-end/restart requirements; Linux evidence does not replace Windows native.
Existing start creates new preparation/request, actual REVIEW/CONFIRM and explicit original ADOPT, then ordinary resource/acceptance/receipt verification.
adopt_body reads original /planning-preview current and adopt POSTs original service-case-plan; ordinary planning is already present.

Read-only baseline lifecycle reference: private Unix socket/new cluster/in-process receipt/exact child process cleanup. Existing source_binding requires Git and old authority hash omits SQL ACL; new contract cannot blindly inherit those limitations.
Original fresh live capture before CREATE and process-local receipt; no pre-existing target adoption or name/path-only authority.
Stop exact owned child references and retain unconfirmed stop; no arbitrary PID cleanup.

future_bounded_groups.design: A real launcher-created new private state: exact empty business/3actor/2resource counts, actual technical ACL and original fresh receipt gate.
Actual normal API+worker original A loop, retained restart/cold read, new B input under original current global Grants; no direct Store.finish/owner business-write shortcut.
Finite retained-state/source/helper/technicalACL drift and occupied-port rejection; private Gitless mirror, no foreign-state adoption or repair.
Narrow actual owned child startup/stop failure and expired-step observation; preserve exact process/response/failure evidence and private tokens without broad old-matrix reruns.

limits: Await final explicit implementation SHA and execution scope before any DB/test/process start.
Only private independent runtime writes; root remains sole controlled-source/Git writer.
No implementation P1/P2 sign-off and no full original AT/project acceptance.
